CLASS Vek
    PUBLIC
    DIM x AS I32
    DIM y AS I32
    CONSTRUCTOR(ax AS I32, ay AS I32)
        x = ax
        y = ay
    END CONSTRUCTOR
    MAGIC ADD(diger AS Vek) AS Vek
        RETURN NEW Vek(THIS.x + diger.x, THIS.y + diger.y)
    END MAGIC
END CLASS
DIM v1 AS Vek = NEW Vek(2, 3)
DIM v2 AS Vek = NEW Vek(4, 1)
DIM v3 AS Vek = v1 + v2
PRINT v3.x
PRINT v3.y
